# Get it running {#setup background-color="#f0674d"}

An app, a sign-in, a folder. No terminal today.

## Install the app {#install}

| If you pay for… | Install | Then |
|---|---|---|
| **Claude** (Pro or Max) | The **Claude** app: [claude.com/download](https://claude.com/download) | Open the **Code** tab |
| **ChatGPT** (Plus or more) | The **ChatGPT** app: [chatgpt.com/download](https://chatgpt.com/download) | Open **Codex** |

1. Download, run the installer, and open the app from the Start menu.
2. **Sign in** with the account you pay for.
3. Already have the app? **Update it** (Help → Check for updates).

[No subscription today? Pair up with your neighbour, and sort one out tonight.
Mac, and everything that can go wrong: **handout, section 1**.]{.small .muted}

## Pick a folder {#folder}

1. Make a folder called `practice` in **Documents** (not in OneDrive).
2. In the app: under the prompt box, **Local**, then **Open folder…** → `practice`.
3. Ask:

::: {.prompt}
What files can you see here? Do not change anything.
:::

Then: **ask it to make a file, read it back to you, and delete it.** Look in the
folder: the file came and went. That's an AI agent on your own machine.

## Install git {#git}

Git lets the agent save a snapshot before it changes anything, so nothing is ever
lost. **Everyone installs it.** You never type git commands; you ask.

::: {.prompt}
Is git installed? If not, install Git for Windows for me, in my user folder if I
don't have admin rights.
:::

- Windows asks **Yes/No**? Click **Yes**.
- Mac: it offers to install developer tools. Click **Install**.

## The row under the prompt box {#row}

| | |
|---|---|
| **Folder** | where it works. One folder per job |
| **Mode** | how often it asks. *Manual* asks before everything; *Accept edits* only before commands; *Auto* only when something looks risky |
| **Model** | *Opus* by default. *Haiku* is fast and cheap, for easy, repetitive work |

**A new session:** Ctrl+N (Mac: Cmd+N). **Stop it:** the stop button, or just type
a correction and press Enter.

## Stuck?

- **The Code tab asks you to upgrade:** that account is on the free plan.
- **The installer is blocked:** that's IT's security software. Hand up.
- **Can't find the folder control:** the app is old. Update it.
- **Anything else:** ask the agent. *"Why can't you see my files?"*

## Talk instead of typing {#voice}

**Windows key + H** (Mac: press **Fn** twice), then speak your prompt.

Long prompts are where this pays: *"Here's what I want, here's why, here's what to
watch out for…"* Nobody types that. Everybody says it.

## Finished first?

**You're the help desk.** Get your neighbour running.

You'll learn more fixing someone else's laptop than watching your own succeed.
